name: Watermelon Refresh Sorbet
desc: A Ninja Creami watermelon sorbet, with banana to keep it from freezing icy.

source.evidence: Searched Ninja Creami watermelon sorbet recipes (Food Banjo, I Dream of Ice Cream, Detoxinista, Recipes From A Pantry); none use this fruit combination and gram ratio, which reads as the owner's own formula.

steps: Blend the watermelon, banana, sugar, lime juice and vodka (if using) until smooth. The banana is what keeps watermelon from freezing into an icy block.
Refrigerate about 30 minutes, then pour into a Ninja Creami pint container, no higher than the max fill line.
Lid the pint and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours, until solid.
Spin on the Sorbet setting. If it is crumbly, add 1-2 tbsp water and Re-spin.
